wheel.jaymoskingdoms.horse.let_be.info: Drops its orders and does as horses do.
wheel.jaymoskingdoms.horse.follow.info: Keeps close to you, and catches up if left behind.
wheel.jaymoskingdoms.horse.stay.info: Stands where it is and won't stray.
wheel.jaymoskingdoms.horse.wander.info: Grazes about this spot, never far from it.
wheel.jaymoskingdoms.horse.set_home.info: Where it stands is its home from now on.
wheel.jaymoskingdoms.horse.go_home.info: Makes its own way home and wanders there.
wheel.jaymoskingdoms.horse.ride_on.info: Keeps going without holding forward (or double-tap forward).
wheel.jaymoskingdoms.horse.horses.info: Every horse you own, where it is; call it or send it home.
wheel.jaymoskingdoms.horse.handbook.info: Everything about horses, in one book.
wheel.jaymoskingdoms.horse.no_horse: Look at a horse of yours, or ride one.
wheel.jaymoskingdoms.horse.wary: It won't take orders until it trusts you (trust %s).
